title: Spectral Radius, Vertex Deletion, and Chromatic Number of Signed Graphs
summary: A signed graph $Σ=(G,σ)$ is a graph $G$ with edges given signs $1$ or $-1$ defined by the function $σ$. The adjacency matrix of $Σ$ is defined as per these signs. The relation between the largest eigenvalue of $G$ and $G-v$ has been studied in recent years, where $G-v$ is the graph obtained from $G$ by deleting the vertex $v$. In 2020, Sun and Das proved that the difference of the squares of the largest eigenvalues of the graphs $G$ and $G-v$ is bounded above by $2d(v)-1$ where $d(v)$ is the degree of $v$.
